_readme: NY_SCH - sigom-box-acc-configs-agent phase 1 (gap run). Copied by the run into its versioned folder as acc-configs-inputs.json (scripts/new_run.py --area acc-configs). Devin fills every <...> from evidence or by asking.

target._group_pk: A-G1 Tier 2 PRE and PRE PARALELO [operator, 2026-10-15]; group UNITED STATES, 25 branches; NY SCH is the first in BOX (A-G4 = 0 rows)
target._gbo_schema: GBO schema of T_MAD_REVAL_ACCOUNTS (Cross Account Config source) - PGT_NY for NY in Tier 2 [BOX ACC expert via operator, 2026-10-22]

reference._gbo_schema: GBO schema of T_MAD_REVAL_ACCOUNTS (Cross Account Config source) - PGT_ES in Tier 1 for Madrid and SLB [BOX ACC expert via operator, 2026-10-22]

instruments._source: registry instruments (gate 0c, 2026-09-21); PKs as sigom-box-fe-configs-agent APPROVED_INSTRUMENTS

gbo_source.env: <ask once per run - where NY's GBO configuration is read: the target environment (default) or GBO PRE PARALELO (a recent copy of production; Tier 2 PRE's GBO was older on 2026-10-15: Cross Account Config 17 vs 24 rows)>
gbo_source._source: one GBO source per run, asked once [operator, 2026-10-22, ADR 0015]; every target GBO query runs there, every target BOX query in target.env

usage._comment: no usage window: the scope is configuration (Valid in-scope portfolio properties, full lists) [ADR 0015, 2026-10-22]. The windowed queries are optional diagnostics; NY's July 2026 results (PRE PARALELO) are in box-acc-model.md section 9

expected_structure._source: docs/reference/box-acc-model.md (DB PRE-PROD + cib-boxacc-dbboxacc, 2026-10-14) - the pre-checks compare against these

fixed._source: BOX ACC expert via operator, 2026-10-22 - ADR 0014; never asked
fixed.conditions: BOX as it is (verify only, never created); GBO -> BOX through the condition map; a GBO condition with no BOX twin dropped [BOX expert, 2026-10-28 - ADR 0020]
fixed.conf_instru_type: the reference's BOX rows per instrument, as they are (A-12)
fixed.internal_list_account: the internal account, as the reference's internal lists (INTERNAL)
fixed.global_objects: topics and standard historics missing -> created with the global .65 PK, flagged to review; separate global_pk_rollback.sql in phase 2; conditions / event groups / events never created [BOX ACC expert, 2026-10-27 - ADR 0018]
fixed.out_of_scope: T_PGT_TOPICS_RR and GBO ConcMis - nothing to do [BOX ACC expert, 2026-10-27]
fixed.local_properties: from NY's GBO: per instrument the topics of the in-scope Valid GBO portfolio properties (by CODE, in their GBO list) and their conditions with a BOX twin; not SLB's [BOX expert, 2026-10-28 - ADR 0020]
fixed.portfolio_properties: one BOX property per Valid in-scope GBO property, DESCRIPTION as GBO's, its own topic -> account rows; never merged [BOX expert, 2026-10-28 - ADR 0020]

decisions.portfolio_property_inivalpcdate: <ask - start date for NY's new portfolio properties, >= 1900-01-01 (the local properties'); proposal 1900-01-01: NY's GBO properties start on 01-JAN-00>
decisions.net_contract: <confirm: N/A - NY is not Madrid real>
decisions.eom_ccs_netting: <ask every run - does the CCS end-of-month netting (Net CCS PlanBS, screen 13) apply to NY? yes -> SLB's rows as they are, the operator changes what NY needs; no -> N/A [operator, 2026-10-26]>
decisions.topic_mapping: by CODE - always; a GBO topic with no BOX CODE twin is created as a global topic (.65 PK), flagged to review [BOX ACC expert, 2026-10-27 - ADR 0018]
decisions.delivery: PL/SQL rendered by scripts/render_acc_sql.py from 03-sql/acc-values.json, run by the operator [operator, 2026-10-28 - ADR 0022]
decisions.cds: <ask - CDS in BOX scope for NY? 6 group properties, no branch condition, posting in GBO; FE jobs plan: skip>
decisions.screen4_scope: Valid portfolio properties (ADR 0014) whose branch value is classified in (A-U1 g), full lists; a blank branch condition or no branch row -> out [BOX ACC expert, 2026-10-27]
decisions.pp_clash_mode: <ask every run - (a) hold the clashing portfolio properties for the operator's choice (default) or (b) create them all, the clashing ones end InValid in BOX [operator, 2026-10-28 - ADR 0020]>

pp_clash_choices._comment: per clash group of the report (03-portfolio-properties-report.md section 3): the GBO portfolio property PK to keep, e.g. "otc-1": "2496.35" - filled by the operator (accounting user); the next run (--from) creates it, the others are not carried

multi_account_topics._comment: a topic with several accounts in one GBO portfolio property (A-04i): BOX holds one - asked when found, never chosen by the agent [operator, 2026-10-28 - ADR 0020 point 6]. Seen 2026-10-28 (GBO PRE, operator's recollection; 0 cases in GBO PRE PARALELO, 2026-10-29): 14 cases, OTC 2485.35 / 2487.35, local list, FXCONTROL INTERNAL+TCPV, FXCONTROLNET INTERNAL+TCPA, FXNETLOSS / FXNETPROF / FXNIVELLOSS / FXNIVELPROF / NIVELNET INTERNAL + a 99... account (the real account the newer row)
multi_account_topics.internal_plus_one: <ask when found - for every case INTERNAL + exactly one real account: real (proposed) or internal>

cases._comment: any other pattern: "<gbo port prop pk>|<list>|<topic code>": "<account code to keep>" - asked once per identical case

global_pk._comment: global objects (topics, standard historics) take .65 PKs [operator, 2026-10-28 - ADR 0018, 0022]
global_pk.tier2-dev: next-free (DEV test) - or a range from the BOX team
global_pk.tier2-pre: <BOX team - the agreed .65 range per table (open item 4zx)>

branch_conditions._source: A-U1 (b) / (e), PRE PARALELO [2026-10-15] - the conditions whose function returns the trade's branch; their VALUE_FUNC separates the group's branches

special_codes.INTERNAL: <ask - IRS property 2212.35, no movement or key in July>

branch_conditions._other_codes: the group's other branch seen 2026-10-15; replaced in A-U7 by out_codes [2026-10-23]
branch_conditions.out_codes: <A-U1 (g): each value classified in / out from evidence (function source, the group's branches, family size); operator 2026-10-23 kept NY_SCH only, unsure - provisional until (g) is run>
branch_conditions._blank: a property with no branch condition (blank) or no branch row is out of scope, not asked [BOX ACC expert, 2026-10-27]

label_aliases._file: Equation's code per NY book with jobs (18 books, A-T, G and R not used) [Equation via operator, 2026-10-27]
label_aliases.source: <confirm - proposed 629.4 EQUATION_NY (SLB's labels use 287.4 EQUATION MADRID; 145.4 N.Y. EQUATION also exists) - BOX expert / Equation>

condition_map._file: GBO -> BOX condition pairs and value translations, the same in every environment; found where sure (same field domain, same description), else proposed from both functions (A-04h) and confirmed once per pair [ADR 0020, 2026-10-28]
